title: 50x Caves
description: There are 50 times more caves, in all 3 dimensions.
body:
This datapack makes it so that caves are 50 times more common than usual! (Specifically, every carver is duplicated 50 times, so ravines are *also* more common.)

- The Overworld is mostly recognizable, but below the surface, it's all one giant hollowed-out area.
- The Nether is almost all gone. Only a few patches of blocks remain.
- The End doesn't have any carvers in vanilla Minecraft, so I added End Ravines which cover the ground, on both the central island and outer islands.

(Be warned: This means that world generation takes many times longer than usual!)

<small>_DISCLAIMER: I am not responsible for any mental damage or insanity which may occur while searching for the portal room in a stronghold._</small>
